value.rationale: check_spending_cap returned red: $189.00 exceeds the family's $75 monthly autonomous spending cap, and check_user_override confirms no override is in place. This is a clear policy violation, so rejection (not flag-for-human) is the correct disposition, even though idempotency is clean and the order is internal-only.
value.remediation: Either reduce the order to fall under the $75 cap (e.g. 3 packs of size 4 diapers) or surface the full $189.00 order to a parent for explicit per-action approval / a one-time spending override before re-submitting.
